jobs.title: Legal Consultant - Contract Drafting & Legal Advisory (Saudi Arabia)
jobs.description:
About Us

We develop smart, sustainable, and scalable digital solutions that help organizations simplify and manage business processes efficiently and effectively, transform data into decisions, and unlock new opportunities for growth and innovation.

Website: www.lamdax.sa

Job Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Legal Consultant with strong expertise in drafting and reviewing contracts in compliance with Saudi Arabian laws and regulations.

The consultant will support the company on a project/task basis by preparing, reviewing, and finalizing legal documents and agreements for immediate business use.

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and finalize legal contracts and agreements aligned with Saudi regulations.
  • Prepare board member agreements for both Saudi and non-Saudi individuals.
  • Review existing contracts and provide legal amendments and recommendations.
  • Ensure all legal documents are compliant, enforceable, and ready for immediate use.
  • Provide legal consultation and guidance on company agreements, policies, and documentation.
  • Identify legal risks and propose practical solutions.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in Saudi labor, corporate, and commercial contract drafting.
  • Strong understanding of Saudi legal and regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience handling agreements involving Saudi and non-Saudi board members.
  • Ability to deliver legally sound and business-ready documents independently.
  • Excellent legal writing skills in English (Arabic is a strong advantage).
  • High attention to detail and confidentiality.

Engagement & Payment Structure

This is a freelance/project-based role.

Compensation will be provided per legal task or assignment, such as:

  • Drafting contracts and delivering finalized versions ready for immediate use.
  • Reviewing and editing existing agreements to ensure legal compliance and finalization.
  • Providing legal consultations related to contracts, agreements, or company documents.

The consultant will be engaged based on business needs and specific legal requirements.

jobs.title: Sr Marketing Executive
jobs.description:
Sr Marketing Specialist – Branding, PR & Sales

About Us

We develop smart, sustainable, and scalable digital solutions that help organizations simplify business processes, transform data into decisions, and unlock opportunities for growth and innovation.

Website: www.lamdax.sa

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and commercially minded Sr Marketing Specialist – Branding, PR & Sales to strengthen LamdaX’s brand presence, execute marketing initiatives, support PR activities, and contribute to business growth and sales.

The role combines branding, digital marketing, content, PR, lead generation, and business development support, working closely with management, sales, product, and creative teams.

Key Responsibilities

Branding & Marketing

  • Develop and maintain LamdaX’s brand identity and ensure consistency across all channels.
  • Support brand strategies, campaigns, and marketing initiatives.
  • Research market trends, customer behavior, and competitors to identify opportunities.
  • Develop creative concepts and marketing content that increase brand awareness and engagement.
  • Coordinate with designers, content creators, copywriters, and other creative resources.

Social Media & Content

  • Manage LamdaX’s social media presence and content calendar.
  • Coordinate the creation, review, and publishing of content.
  • Monitor performance and recommend improvements to increase engagement and reach.
  • Ensure all content reflects LamdaX’s brand voice and visual identity.

Public Relations (PR)

  • Support PR strategies and initiatives to strengthen LamdaX’s public image and market presence.
  • Coordinate PR campaigns, announcements, media materials, and external communications.
  • Identify relevant media, industry, and networking opportunities that increase brand visibility.
  • Maintain consistent messaging across external communications and public-facing channels.

Sales & Business Development

  • Support lead-generation and customer acquisition initiatives.
  • Identify and qualify potential business opportunities.
  • Conduct market and customer research to understand target audiences and opportunities.
  • Assist with lead follow-up and business development activities.

Campaign & Project Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing projects from concept through execution.
  • Manage timelines, approvals, revisions, and deliverables.
  • Translate business requirements into clear creative briefs and actionable tasks.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies or freelancers when required.

Reporting & Performance

  • Track marketing, social media, brand, and lead-generation KPIs.
  • Prepare regular performance reports and evaluate campaign effectiveness.
  • Use data and customer insights to recommend improvements.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Graphic Design, or a related field.
  • 4 years+ of relevant experience in marketing, branding, PR, social media, account management, or a related role.
  • Practical experience in brand management and marketing campaign execution.
  • Understanding of digital marketing, social media, PR, and customer engagement.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Creative thinking combined with commercial and business awareness.
  • Experience working with creative teams and external resources.

Preferred Skills

  • Brand Strategy & Management
  • Public Relations
  • Social Media & Content Marketing
  • Digital Marketing
  • Creative Direction
  • Sales & Lead Generation
  • Market & Trend Analysis
  • Client/Account Management
  • Project Management
  • Presentation & Communication
  • Negotiation
  • Graphic Design understanding

Key Competencies

  • Creativity & Innovation
  • Commercial Awareness
  • Brand Ownership
  • Communication
  • Collaboration
  • Organization & Execution
  • Problem Solving
  • Customer Focus

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the ability to:

  • Strengthen and maintain a consistent LamdaX brand identity.
  • Increase brand awareness, engagement, and PR visibility.
  • Deliver effective marketing and PR campaigns on time.
  • Generate and support qualified sales opportunities.
  • Improve marketing effectiveness using data and customer insights.
  • Build strong collaboration between marketing, sales, creative, and management teams.
